values.description: api-service as seen from a container on the compose network (for example a Newman container or a Jenkins agent attached to the remit network). From anywhere else override it: newman ... --env-var baseUrl=http://<host>:<port>/api/v1
REMIT_OPERATOR_PASSWORD from .env; pass with --env-var operatorPassword=... Never commit it.
REMIT_ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env; pass with --env-var adminPassword=... Never commit it.
